attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, node3 (initial standbys) on RHEL10. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, then rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup as a standby of node2. Verified data consistency at each stage. Completed mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node3, then node2 (final primary) one at a time, each confirmed via changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, with PostgreSQL service and replication/recovery state verified healthy after each restart, and a final end-to-end write (row 6) confirmed replicated to both standbys.
